# WJ Group Leads the Way in Road Worker Safety with Safety Cloud

WJ Group, the UK’s largest road marking and highway maintenance provider, constantly looks for new ways to protect its crews and the public. Working just feet from fast-moving traffic creates risks that traditional cones and barriers cannot fully address.

To close those gaps, WJ Group became the first in the UK to adopt Safety Cloud digital alerting. This connected safety technology delivers real-time warnings to drivers, helping reduce the chance of dangerous incursions into work zones.

The full case study reveals how WJ Group:

- Integrated Safety Cloud into its nationwide fleet
- Strengthened protection for crews on short-duration, high-risk projects
- Enhanced communication with the public and supported local authority safety goals
